player_prompt.intro:
Welcome to Lights Out! You have a {size}x{size} grid of lights.
Your goal is to turn ALL lights OFF (represented by '.')
When you press a light, it toggles itself AND its adjacent neighbors (up/down/left/right).
Type [row col] to press a light (0-indexed, so valid range is 0-{max_index}).
You have up to {max_turns} moves to solve the puzzle.
Legend: 'O' = light ON, '.' = light OFF

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sochii [row col] foormaatiin barreessu qabda, achitti row fi col lakkoofsa 0 hanga {max_index} jiddutti ta'a.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Koordineetotaan 0 fi {max_index} gidduu ta'uu qaba. Ati [{row},{col}] barreesse.

outcome.win: Galatoomi! Ati sochii {moves_used} keessatti qubeela kana hiikeetta!
